{{Quote|I'm just a technicial in borrowed armor.|Sogan Varga, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DR" />}}
'''Sogan Varga''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] technician who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Well, I'm a tech...not really a combatant. All I had was a torn up pair of coveralls. The other guys started to collect armor pieces for me. Judging from the smell, the armor probably came from the undead.|Sogan Varga, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:WNP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Who Needs Perfume?|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Sogan Varga was present on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] when an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|accident]] took place in the [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]].<ref name="SWG:DR" /> The [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] that was studied there escaped containment and decimated most of the people in the area, turning them into starving [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures. In response, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] promptly established a [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] to contain the infection.<ref name="SWG:MMR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mysterious Meeting Request|Dathomir}}</ref> The few people who survived the initial virus outbreak, including Sogan Varga,<ref name="SWG:DR" /> were trapped in the Quarantine Zone. The survivors established camps in order to to repel the regular assaults of the zombies and try to live in safety while waiting for an evacuation.<ref name="SWG:MMR" />

[[File:Camp_Epsilon.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Camp Epsilon]] in the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].]]
Sogan Varga took shelter in [[Camp Epsilon]], the most unsafe camp since it was located in the courtyard of the Imperial Research and Prison Facility, the place where lived the most dangerous undeads.<ref name="SWG:DR" /> Other survivors in the camp at that time included the former prisoner [[Zsu Val]]<ref name="SWG:FWEC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Forward Watch, Epsilon Camp|Dathomir}}</ref>, the mechanic [[Nils Cridmeen]],<ref name="SWG:SP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Shuttle Parts|Dathomir}}</ref> the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Klex Fulgor]],<ref name="SWG:AA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Administrative Access|Dathomir}}</ref> and the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] [[GT-643]], [[KD-121]] and [[HX-138]].<ref name="SWG:FtS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find the Stormtroopers|Dathomir}}</ref>

Later, a spacer arrived at Camp Epsilon and delivered a [[Radionics|radio]] to Sogan Varga. The radio was provided by the [[TIE pilot|Imperial pilot]] [[Jeb Maris]] in [[Camp Alpha]] who had decided to establish communications between the camps. Once radios were delivered to the five camps in the Quarantine Zone, the survivors were able to safely coordinate high altitude supply drops sent from outside the Quarantine Zone.<ref name="SWG:DR" />

Meanwhile, a group of spacers helped the survivors refugees of camp Camp Epsilon to repair a damaged [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] present in the camp.<ref name="SWG:SP" /> The survivors and the spacers eventually escaped the Quarantine Zone altogether with the shuttle.<ref name="SWG:E">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Escape|Dathomir}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Sogan Varga was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Sogan Varga was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
